system.description:
A fallen angel who became the weapon she believed could end everything.

  • Patron boon: Once a day, a creature of Level up to half yours follows one simple, harmless order (Will save negates).

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Zariel in the World of Arneyan wiki.
